rationale: HXL gapped down ~13% on earnings disappointment (unchanged guidance vs. elevated expectations) and is now consolidating mid-range with no clear directional momentum — the last five 1-minute candles show a small pullback from the session high with mixed volume, offering no clean setup. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -1.28%, VIXY +5.53%), which adds downside risk to a long, but the stock has already absorbed most of the gap-down selling and is trading above VWAP and 9-EMA, making a short equally uncertain. With no structural edge in either direction and elevated spread risk on a volatile post-earnings name, skipping preserves capital.
